MONO-1.method: finite difference on the 13 adjacent segments of the declared 14-value w grid, at every committed P row and every theta; segments that straddle the clamp are reported separately and compared against the clamp-implied slope
MONO-1.statement: d(Delta)/d(log2 w) = +0.5 exactly under MC_P13 while log2 w < L_mem(P) and 0 exactly at or above it; -0.5 exactly under MC_VOW wherever the assessed method is feasible.

MONO-2.method: bisection on a backward finite-difference slope of the assembled Delta (h = 1e-11), 200 iterations; this measures the kink of the assembled function rather than reading the min() clamp
MONO-2.statement: The kink in Delta versus log2 w under MC_P13 sits at exactly L_mem(P) for the five committed rows.

MONO-3.statement: p*(w) is non-increasing in w under MC_P13 and non-decreasing under MC_VOW, wherever at least two numeric loci exist within one theta; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE(n = count), NEVER pass.

MONO-4.statement: MC_P13 and MC_VOW differ by at least 0.5 bits in Delta at some evaluated cell with log2 w >= 10.

MONO-5.kind: DATA CHECK on the 5 committed T2 rows
MONO-5.why_it_matters: L_paper(P) - P/3 is the only in-corpus handle on the superpolynomial o(1) term.
